rooms.name: Trail
rooms.desc: A path winds up through dense forest toward a bare hill heaped with black stone cairns; storm clouds pile overhead and lightning lances the top.
rooms.dm: The path leaves the forest floor here and climbs round the east slope at 1 in 5, by two landings, crosses both tracks of Y2 on the south-east and runs over the top to the boulder ring's north gap (Summit level).

rooms.name: Wall of Fog
rooms.desc: Westward everything simply ends: a wall of fog rises out of sight.
rooms.dm: Marks the boundary of Strahd's domain; the old mountain folk called it the Whispering Wall.

objects.label: Wall of fog

objects.desc: A fifty-foot effigy of woven sticks stuffed with black soil: a giant fanged figure in a cloak, roots coiled round its feet.
An enormous gnarled tree oozing dark red sap, an axe bright in its trunk and a skeleton among its roots.

objects.label: Up through dense forest to a bare hill of black cairns under massing storm clouds, lightning on the top; westward the world ends in fog. The book has the hill rise about 400 ft from the forest; the map draws its top 271 ft above the forest floor, the trail climbing at 1 in 5 or less.
Looking west from the summit or the west slope: a pale castle above a far-off city seems to float in the fog, and a bell tolls faintly. It is an illusion. Entering the fog: Mists of Ravenloft (ch.2).

Tokens on this level stand on the forest floor round the hill. The trail climbs from here to the top (half an hour), and each stair marker takes the party on up it: two landings on the slope (94 and 178 ft), the outer track (254 ft), then the summit, where the inner track, the druids' circle and the Gulthias tree are.
Heights: the hilltop and the inner track 271 ft above the forest floor, the outer track 254 ft; the slopes below it are as steep as 1 in 2.
Y2: the cairn tracks (Outer track and Summit levels)
Y3: the druids' circle (Summit level)
Y4: the Gulthias tree (Summit level)
The party comes up the trail from the north-east

rooms.dm: The trail's lower landing: on up to the upper landing, or back down to the forest floor.

rooms.name: Druids' Circle
rooms.desc: Withered turf inside a circle of black boulders five to ten feet tall, broken by two paths; the stick-and-soil effigy of a fanged, cloaked man looms over it.
rooms.dm: Twelve hidden turf-covered graves (six druids, six berserkers). The gem is in the statue's chest. Lightning may strike anyone who climbs the ring.

rooms.name: Gulthias Tree
rooms.desc: Dead trees and brush round an enormous gnarled tree oozing dark sap; spiny, gangly shapes prowl about it; an axe shines in the trunk above a skeleton.
rooms.dm: Gulthias tree; 6 needle blights in plain view, 3 vine and 12 twig blights hiding.

The vineyard's stolen magic gem (a glowing green pinecone-sized gem) planted in the effigy's chest: climb and dig (d20 >= 13); drops out glowing when the effigy falls.
Wintersplinter (tree blight) - only after the Druids' Ritual: bursts from the statue with the gem in its heart and marches on the Wizard of Wines

Two dirt tracks circle the slope, each edged with ten-foot cairns of slick black stone: graves of an old berserker tribe, untouched for centuries. The inner track is this level's; the outer one lies 18 ft lower, under the brow (the Outer track level, by the trail).
Statue: AC 10, 50 hp, immune poison and psychic; oil + fire = 2d6 fire a round. Gulthias roots hold it up. Destroyed: the gem tumbles out glowing green.
Climbing over the boulders: 10% chance of a lightning strike, 44 (8d10) lightning. The two trail gaps are safe.
Six druids and six berserkers sleep under sod covers; they rise if anyone approaches or harms the statue, or once found and attacked. Replenished at dusk (1d4-1 of each a day, up to six).

Druids' Ritual: when Strahd comes (on Beucephalus or as a bat) the druids rise and chant for 10 rounds; Wintersplinter, a tree blight, bursts from the statue and marches north on the Wizard of Wines. Needs room for a Huge creature.
